summary: Sangoma Technologies, a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Arrangement Agreement under which BRC Group Holdings will acquire all outstanding shares via an Ontario plan of arrangement. Consideration is US$4.925 cash plus 0.04767 BRC shares per share. The board, on a special committee recommendation, unanimously approved and recommends the deal. Directors and officers holding roughly 27% signed voting and support agreements. Closing requires two-thirds shareholder approval, a majority-of-the-minority vote, court sanction, HSR, Investment Canada Act, FCC and state regulatory clearances, with dissent rights capped at 10%. A special meeting is expected on or before December 11, 2026. Watch regulatory timing and dissent levels for spread risk.
